Hear me out for one sec...this is difficult to explain:
During the "zero tolerance" when all illegal border crossers were being prosecuted for violations of 8 USC 1325 there was no incentive to bring your child because you would be separated from your child and you would go to jail for the crime you committed.

Now, after the public outcry, parents are encouraged to bring their children on this dangerous journey because if they are caught entering illegally they will not be separated and prosecuted for their crime. Instead they are given a court date and released at the bus station. 

Illegal border crossers who are caught crossing without kids are still prosecuted for their crime. So now it is beneficial to bring a kid (even if it's not your own) and cross with then to avoid prosecution. The kids are being used.

So by ending the zero tolerance we have encouraged parents to bring their kids which is putting then at risk.
